About.title: Live air has no second take.
About.p1: From 2019 to 2022 I mixed live TV broadcasts at the console on major Ukrainian channels; before and after that I worked as a location sound engineer. On air everything is checked before you go live, and when something breaks in the middle of a long marathon broadcast, you fix it calmly, in seconds, while the whole crew relies on you.
About.p2: In October 2025 I started the GoIT Fullstack program, led two team projects and began building websites for real clients. The habits from the studio came with me: prepare before release, keep things predictable and write code that is easy to hand over.

timeline.detail: KNUCA, then sound recording on set
At the console on major Ukrainian channels
Sound on location for TV broadcasts
Client sites live on custom domains
